race.description: Riverina Crane Services Heat Of The Rising Star Hcp (C1)
race.comment: HAY DEER (7) holds top billing after a controlled debut win at Goulburn, where she was well found in betting and beat On The Fly by just over two lengths over this distance. That gives her the cleanest 1200m profile among the main chances, and she looks capable of taking the next step. GRAYNITA (9) resumes with form that reads well for this grade, having placed in a Class 2 at Corowa before a sound BM58 sixth at Moruya when slow away and forced wide late. Her 1200m record is not dominant, but the standard of her last campaign keeps her right in play. REBEL TERRA (5) has done little wrong in two starts, improving from an outsider's debut third to a Nowra Mdn win where he overcame a check and still finished with authority. ANGLING FOR INFO (1) resumes with a host of gear changes from the inside draw. Never handled the Ballarat Synthetic track with a fading eighth over 1200m on June 26. Fitted with the one trial and assess on the win two back.
